sources.snippet: IndicXlit is a transformer-based multilingual transliteration model (~11M) that supports 21 Indic languages for Roman to native script and native to Roman script conversions. It is trained on Aksharantar dataset which is the largest publicly available parallel corpus containing 26 million word pairs spanning 20 Indic languages at the time of writing (5 May 2022).
